note: The race numbers expected off the two photographs the owner supplied for #227 and two of the Commons fixtures, with the box each number sits in as fractions of the file. The third-party race photograph the reader was also measured on is not in the repository; its reads are in docs/specs/models.md. Boxes were taken from the ppocr Detector's first run at the Decode Bound (6 Sep 2026) and checked by eye against the photograph; `tolerance` is how far a found centre may sit from them. `misses` are numbers a person reads that no candidate reader found (a tilted 2 read as 5 under the score floor): a reader that finds one is better than this file and the entry moves to `numbers` on purpose. `others` are numbers a person can make out in the background that the reader may or may not find. A `number` Region whose label is in none of the three lists is a false read.
